background: Born and raised in Ridgewood, Queens, by Kosovar-Albanian parents; her family lives by besa, the sacred promise to protect a guest at any cost.
regionalHistory: Mountain villages where, within memory, families sheltered neighbors of every faith.
culturalBaseline: European Muslim; hospitality is a code of honor more than a ritual.
communicationStyle: Earnest, principled, warm under a serious surface.
